# iniBuilds Forum

> > The central community hub for iniBuilds flight simulation aircraft, product support, and development updates.

iniBuilds Forum is a dedicated community platform for users of iniBuilds aircraft addons and the iniManager product ecosystem. The forum hosts official announcements, technical support, development updates, and community discussions centered around high-fidelity aircraft for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

## Key Topics

- iniBuilds
- iniManager
- Aircraft Development
- A350-1000
- A320/A321/A330
- Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
- Hardware Compatibility
- Winwing MCDU
- Freeware Content
- Community Support
- WASM
- Product Announcements
- Flight Simulation
- Technical Support
- Liveries & Downloads

## Core Hub & Navigation

- [iniBuilds Forum](https://forum.inibuilds.com): Main community forum hub for support, announcements, and aircraft discussion
- [Downloads - iniBuilds Forum](https://forum.inibuilds.com/files): File repository for iniBuilds addons, liveries, and community content downloads
- [All Activity - iniBuilds Forum](https://forum.inibuilds.com/discover): Forum activity feed showing recent discussions and bug reports

## Announcements & Updates

- [iniBuilds Announcements](https://forum.inibuilds.com/forum/7-inibuilds-announcements): Official iniBuilds announcements for aircraft and scenery development
- [Announcements](https://forum.inibuilds.com/forum/4-announcements): General forum announcements and iniManager product updates
- [iniManager Announcements](https://forum.inibuilds.com/forum/148-inimanager-announcements): iniManager product announcements and release notes
- [iniBuilds Aircraft Development Update - March 2026](https://forum.inibuilds.com/topic/35855-inibuilds-aircraft-development-update-march-2026): Development update on TriStar Airliner and A300-600R aircraft progress
- [iniManager v2.5.2 Released](https://forum.inibuilds.com/topic/35699-inimanager-v252-released): iniManager v2.5.2 release notes with bug fixes and improvements

## Product Discussion & Support

- [iniBuilds](https://forum.inibuilds.com/forum/1-inibuilds): Main iniBuilds forum section for aircraft and product discussion
- [Freeware Content](https://forum.inibuilds.com/forum/17-freeware-content): Support forum for iniBuilds freeware aircraft and hardware compatibility
- [iniBuilds A320/21/30 compatibility with Winwing MCDU](https://forum.inibuilds.com/topic/35746-inibuilds-a3202130-compability-with-winwing-mcdu): Support thread for Winwing MCDU hardware compatibility with iniBuilds aircraft
- [Xbox a350 out of Zurich](https://forum.inibuilds.com/topic/35954-xbox-a350-out-of-zurich): Technical support thread for A350-1000 crash issues at Zurich airport

## Community Discussion

- [General Discussion](https://forum.inibuilds.com/forum/2-general-discussion): General and off-topic discussion forum for community members
